response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack engineer with 15+ years across web, embedded, and infrastructure work, and has recent exposure to AI-agent tooling (MCP frameworks), but his profile lacks the cloud/AI strategic depth, advanced AI credentials, and director/principal-level scope required for this role. His career has been largely hands-on IC engineering rather than AI strategy, customer advisory, or cross-org technical leadership.
strengths: Broad technical range across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure systems
Entrepreneurial track record as founder/maintainer of an open-source GIS platform (GISCollective)
Recent hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling at re:cinq
concerns: No advanced degree or formal specialization in AI/ML; limited demonstrated AI product depth
Career progression shows Staff/Senior-level titles, not Director/Principal-level strategic leadership
No evidence of cloud platform expertise or experience advising strategic customers/partners on AI adoption

key_factors.factor: Seniority/title level mismatch vs Director-level IC requirement
Recent AI-agent tooling experience and entrepreneurial project (GISCollective)
